# Phone Sign-In Requirements Checklist: Sign in with a phone number and a code sent by WhatsApp

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of the auth API, WhatsApp delivery, rate limits, privacy and the sign-in dialog
**Created**: 2026-10-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist` in an autonomous `/speckit-auto` run; the run reviewed every item itself. `[x]` means the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied (after a fix to spec.md or contracts/ where noted); `[~]` struck means it does not apply, with the reason.

## Auth API completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the request fields of both routes listed completely, including the language of a new account? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006] (fixed: `language` added to FR-006, as the contract had it)
- [x] CHK002 Is "possible phone number" defined with measurable criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001] (fixed: `+` then 7 to 15 digits, first not 0, as research R3)
- [x] CHK003 Is every status code and error `code` of each route listed once, with its trigger? [Completeness, Spec Assumptions, contracts/auth-phone.md]
- [x] CHK004 Is the order in which `phone-sign-in` checks a code unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK005 Is the outcome of a right code for each account state (matched, suspended, deleted, unverified phone, none) specified? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007, §FR-008, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK006 Do the spec and the contract agree on maintenance for a code request from an admin's number? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, contracts/auth-phone.md] (fixed: the contract said "no admin exception"; it now follows FR-010)
- [x] CHK007 Is the body of a matched account's call that also carries a name and consent defined? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-008, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK008 Is "exactly one session or one account per code" under concurrency measurable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-009, SC-003]
- [x] CHK009 Are the unknown-field, non-JSON and prototype-key refusals defined for both routes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011]

## WhatsApp delivery

- [x] CHK010 Is "does not answer in time" quantified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005] (fixed: 5 seconds, as plan Performance Goals)
- [x] CHK011 Are all causes of `whatsapp_failed` listed, and is it stated that no code is stored and the hourly share is not spent? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §FR-004]
- [x] CHK012 Is the content of the message bounded (code and validity only, no link, no name) and its language stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK013 Is the dependency on the outside Brevo template approval and its interim behaviour documented? [Dependency, Spec Assumptions]
- [x] CHK014 Is it stated why the code bypasses the notifications outbox and that it is not counted as an SMS? [Assumption, Spec §FR-002, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK015 Is the non-production allow-list behaviour specified? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-005, Edge Cases]
- [~] CHK016 Are delivery receipts or "message read" states required? [Gap] Struck: not in the story; the person learns of failure only from the synchronous Brevo answer, which FR-005 covers.

## Rate limits and guessing

- [x] CHK017 Are the three limits (60 s, 5 per hour per number, 20 per hour per address) each quantified with their window type? [Measurability, Spec §FR-004, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK018 Is the behaviour when Redis is down specified, and which guarantees still hold? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-004, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK019 Is the brute-force bound (attempts per code, codes per hour) stated so the guessing risk is judgeable? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004, US3]
- [x] CHK020 Is the same-second double request defined? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases, SC-003]
- [x] CHK021 Is the source of the per-address key defined? [Dependency, Spec §FR-004 (080-FR-016)]

## Privacy

- [x] CHK022 Is non-disclosure of whether an account holds a number defined, and its accepted exceptions listed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-006, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK023 Is what is stored for a code, and for how long, stated without ambiguity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Key Entities] (fixed: Key Entities now says what the row holds and that nothing sweeps it)
- [x] CHK024 Are logging limits for the number and the code stated? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK025 Is what is audited (only "account created") and what is not stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK026 Is consent capture for a new account specified with its versions and method? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [~] CHK027 Is Brevo's role as a processor of the number stated for the privacy notice? [Gap] Struck: the processor list belongs to the privacy notice (ST-132); Brevo already processes WhatsApp numbers for ST-392.

## Sign-in dialog

- [x] CHK028 Are the controls, labels and input attributes of each of the three steps listed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, §FR-013, §FR-015]
- [x] CHK029 Are focus and screen-reader requirements for step changes defined? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013] (fixed: focus to the first field, heading announced, visible labels)
- [x] CHK030 Is a message defined for every answer, in both languages, in an announced region? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, §FR-016]
- [x] CHK031 Are the countdown, the 60 s resend and their server authority defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK032 Are the double-tap and in-flight states defined? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK033 Are offline and the return to e-mail with the typed number kept defined? [Coverage, Spec US4 §3, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK034 Are the viewport, theme and language matrix and the no-sideways-scroll rule measurable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-016, SC-004]
- [x] CHK035 Is the gap that the phone option is not designed recorded with its source? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions, design.md]

## Tests and traceability

- [x] CHK036 Does each success criterion name its check and its number? [Measurability, Spec SC-001..SC-004]
